Let \(t=\lg(\log_2 10)=\log_{10}(\log_2 10)\).
Since \(\log_2 10=\frac1{\lg 2}\), we have
\[
t=\lg\left(\frac1{\lg 2}\right)=-\lg(\lg 2).
\]
So the target argument is
\[
\lg(\lg 2)=-t.
\]

Let \(g(x)=ax^3+b\sin x\), which is odd. Then \(f(x)=g(x)+4\).  
Given \(f(t)=5\), so \(g(t)=1\). Thus
\[
f(-t)=g(-t)+4=-g(t)+4=-1+4=3.
\]

\[
\boxed{3}
\]
